parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(ss.sh_id) AS total_shipments_created,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.current_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_shipments,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.current_status != 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_delivered_shipments,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.sh_domain = 'Domestic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS domestic_shipments,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.sh_domain = 'International' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS international_shipments,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ser_type = 'Express' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS express_shipments,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ser_type = 'Regular' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS regular_shipments,
  SUM(ss.sh_charges) AS total_shipment_charges_collected,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status != 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_payments_count
FROM shipmentstatus ss
LEFT JOIN payment_details p ON ss.sh_id = p.sh_id;
